title: Multi-select can only delete — no bulk disable, breakpoint, duplicate, or align operations
existing_state: The canvas has a complete selection model (shift-click toggle, drag rectangle — App.tsx) but selecting 2+ blocks renders only a '{n} blocks selected' placeholder in the Properties panel (panels/Properties.tsx:1577-1594). The block context menu operates on the single right-clicked nodeId only (BlockContextMenu.tsx:62, removeNodes([nodeId]) at :115-118). The sole multi-node operation is keyboard Delete. There is no bulk disable/enable, bulk breakpoint set/clear, multi-duplicate, or align/distribute — table stakes in comparable node editors. This overlaps the FLOW_CANVAS_ENHANCEMENTS.md roadmap ('Multi-Select Action Bar + Bulk Ops', lines 154-155, rated Impact 4 / Effort M).
recommendation: Per the roadmap, render a floating action bar (React Flow's NodeToolbar with nodeId={selectedIds} or a fixed strip above the canvas) when selectedNodeIds.size > 1, offering: Disable/Enable all (loop toggleDisabled), Set/Clear breakpoints (loop toggleBreakpoint), Duplicate (reuse utils/clipboard.ts copy+paste), Delete with count confirmation, and Align left/top (single undo snapshot + layout autosave). Alternatively start smaller: replace the Properties placeholder with these as buttons.
user_benefit: Debugging a 60-block preset routinely means 'disable these five blocks' or 'breakpoint this whole branch' — today that is five separate right-click round-trips. Bulk gestures collapse minutes of clicking into one.
